info.title: Glade Amazon API
info.description: Normalized Amazon product, search, seller, category, offer, review, deal, and estimate data.

get.description: Get normalized product details using exactly one identifier: ASIN, URL, or GTIN.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A canonical HTTPS product URL on a supported Amazon host.

parameters.name: gtin
parameters.description: A valid ISBN-10, UPC, EAN, or GTIN value.

X-Request-Id.description: Unique request identifier for support and audit trails.

X-Glade-Schema-Version.description: Version of the normalized public response schema.

X-Glade-Cache.description: Whether the response was a cache hit, miss, or stale fallback.

X-Glade-Data-Fetched-At.description: Upstream result creation time, preserved across cache hits.

X-Glade-Usage-Units.description: Customer units consumed by this operation.
